song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Thus — self-consciousness, established from the first, never to be effected; the self, no lord and yet lord;
whose place and time are full of its own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava, Lord, I praise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svasaṃvedanam ādisiddham asādhyam ātmānam anīśam īśam | svaśaktisaṃpūrṇavadeśakālaṃ nityaṃ vibhuṃ bhairavanātham īḍe

verses.craft: Paradox held without blinking (established-yet-uneffected, no-lord-yet-lord); obscure place-time glossed neutral per UNC; I-praise performs.
verses.rejected: (a) resolving paradox → killed: holding is the verse. (b) hail for praise → killed: L3 frozen.
